system.description:
You create a puddle of Water mixed with oil, producing bubbles that float around you. These bubbles are then launched at a point you can see within range, then filling a 20-foot cube, centered on this point. Creatures of your choice, who first enter the chosen area or who begin their turn within it must make a Dexterity saving throw taking 2d10 cold damage, 2d10 bludgeoning damage and being Staggered on a failure, or half as much on a successful save.

As a Bonus action for the duration, you can select a new point within range, firing these bubbles, filling a new area and forcing creatures to make their saving throws against the effects of this jutsu.

Hydrofication. You count as invisible to all creatures that fail their saving throw.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d10 for each damage type.
